content.comment_body: I am currently using the newly released version of [product_name] [version_no]. When deploying a project to AWS and creating a new environment, the automatically selected non-deprecated Tomcat platform appears incompatible with the application, resulting in the error: "Application's Java version is lower than the environment's." As a consequence, the dashboard is non-functional. Downgrading to an older, deprecated platform resolves the issue, but this platform may soon be unavailable without prior notice. I am concerned that this could impact all customer dashboards. What solutions are available for this problem? Are there updated policies or requirements that should be addressed? Best regards, [user_name]
We advise using Java Corretto 11 for [product_name] [version_no]. Further details can be found in the attached [document].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing a major compatibility problem when deploying projects with [product_name] [version_no] on AWS. The automatic selection of the Tomcat platform by AWS causes a Java version mismatch, resulting in non-functional dashboards unless a deprecated environment is used.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate seamless deployment of the [product_name] [version_no] application to non-deprecated AWS environments, with no Java compatibility problems or interruptions to customer dashboards.
